title: Digital Tyre Inflator - AIROJET 2000 LCV W
description: Wall Mountable - LED digital tyre inflator with pleasant LED display for attractive night visibility.
subtitle: Wall Mountable - LED
fullDescription: LED display wall mountable digital tyre inflator with attractive night visibility and machine shade available for daylight visibility. Features intelligent single digital readouts both for set pressure and tyre pressure, and can be used for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck.
features: Intelligent single digital readouts both for set pressure and tyre pressure
Pleasant LED display for attractive night visibility and machine shade available for daylight visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even after power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
25/35 key for easy front and back tyre pressure setting
Can use for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck

specifications.inputAirHose: 6mm x 2mtrs Black braider Hose with suitable fittings
specifications.inputFilter: 1/4 x 5 micron air filter with suitable fittings
specifications.outputAirHose: 10 mtrs 8 x5 mm Coiled PU hose with clip on Air chuck
specifications.keypad: Membrane Keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.dimensions: 275 x 110 x 275 mm (Control panel), 275 x 135 x 325 mm (Control panel with clamp), 435 x 315 x 435 mm (Packing)
